neighbours.label: words marking that actions overlap in time or are already in progress (simultaneously, at once in parallel, already running, continuous); sequential wording stays low
fire: At the concert, both screens lit up simultaneously above the stage.
The program checks whether the server is already running before it starts.
In the lab, the three samples were heated simultaneously in one oven.
If the download has already started, closing the window will not stop it.
The nurse kept a continuous infusion going for the whole operation.
Our two kitchens prepare the meals simultaneously every evening.
When the update is already in progress, the button is greyed out.
Each chip runs four threads simultaneously to speed up rendering.
quiet: At the concert, the two screens lit up one by one above the stage.
The program checks whether the server is installed before it starts.
In the lab, the three samples were heated in turn in one oven.
If the download has finished, closing the window will not delete it.
The nurse gave a single injection at the start of the operation.
Our two kitchens prepare the meals separately every evening.
When the update is finished, the button turns green again.
Each chip runs four threads in sequence to save power.

notes: Card peaks: simultaneously, already started, running, continuous, in parallel, InProgress; - pole suppresses simultaneous/concurrent. Probe: 'turn on simultaneously' 0.392, 'already running,' 0.383, continuous drip 0.215, while heating 0.147, in parallel 0.134; sequential 'one after the other' 0.103, 'and then started' 0.016.
